startup.fix: Allow the required commands in the CLI permission settings before running headless.

startup.pattern: unsupported model|invalid model|model .*(not supported|not found|not available)|not supported when using
startup.fix: Choose a model supported by the logged-in account in .orchestra/config.json.
Install bubblewrap and socat on Linux (or the sandbox dependencies named in stderr), then retry `orchestra adapter test claude`.

startup.pattern: not logged in|please log.?in|login required|authentication (failed|required)|invalid api key
startup.fix: Run `claude login` on this machine, then retry the adapter test.

startup.what: the installed CLI does not support an adapter flag
startup.fix: Update claude or override its adapter flags in .orchestra/adapters/claude.json to match the installed version.
